order: Validate selected party, capacity, positive toolbox count and HM/Water requirement before destructive entry effects.
Present source-disclosed restrictions before accepting entry; no automatic bank/storage deposit.
Native forced-save flag follows exact restriction row; browser autosave design must not simulate cartridge corruption.
On fresh run only: zero forbidden toolbox/selected held items and/or carried money.
Project selected roster to actors; for reset dungeons replace listed effective fields from current species level1 profile.
Add any required escort/rescue helper only when four-slot/six-body capacity allows; initialize full entry state.
Never rerun entry deletion/level reset on quicksave/rescue resume.

Clear IN_SHOP stock; keep ordinary possessions.
Promote fulfilled jobs8→9.
Clean inventory: Poké objects→money, compact.
For existing entrants use ordinary full field copy or reset held-only copy.

Pass native result class to scenario-specific return route.

Copy remaining actors to dungeonTeam.
If theft flag: transform existing bag items into Plain Seed before outer loss roll.
Discard uncommitted recruits/helpers; settle surviving existing entrants using ordinary full-copy or reset held-only rule.
Return LOST mode; clear progressed jobs.

Run scenario-specific return scene/day transition.

steps: decrement rescues remaining once
preserve leader actor before ordinary deletion/held loss
save exact dungeon state before copyback
settle current ordinary permanent fields / reset held-only fields, but do not add pending recruits
write dungeon quicksave and persistent player save
return to awaiting-rescue menu, no town/day/lossroll
Read same saved dungeon state, no fresh entry restrictions or level reset.

Preserve run level/EXP/underlying stats/itemboosts/moves/links/Ginseng/IQ/tactic/helditems/maxBelly.

Remove IN_SHOP items.

Unlike rescue waiting, quicksave3 skips ordinary growth copyback; this is NOT the same as intentional in-dungeon GiveUp. Browser storage should not invent native cartridge invalidation behavior.

gates: ordinary Orb-use restrictions still apply, including boss/floorwide room policy

mission-escape.classification: successful retention, fulfilled jobs eligible; not global dungeon-clear flag

individual-return.existingOrdinary: Settle run growth/moves/IQ/tactic; clear held item; remove nonleader on-team selection; retain permanent individual. This includes normal send-home and fainting.
individual-return.existingReset: Do not copy level/EXP/stats/moves/IQ/tactic; clear held item; remove nonleader on-team selection.
individual-return.dojoException: Individual faint/send-home skips held-item deletion. A removed nonleader is off-team before outer loss and retains that item; a still-on-team leader/forced partner still loses held item in outer failure cleanup.
individual-return.newRecruit: Faint/send-home discards negative-ID recruit rather than safely recruiting it.
individual-return.forcedPartner: Before leader switching is enabled, partner faint forces run failure. Client failure forces failure; neither becomes a permanent recruit.

day-and-destination.rule: Resolve native outcome code AND script dungeon/current scenario. No outcome alone establishes day+1.
sourceDispatch: GetReturnMap chooses mapID2 for WIN and mapID3 otherwise, with Tiny/fugitive scenario exceptions.
GETOUT_T00E01A for dojos dispatches EVENT_DIVIDE, no unconditional next-day call.
EVENT_S00E01A_L001 failure route explicitly calls NEXT_DAY_FUNC; ordinary day-return follows own scene.
Checkpoint clears are settlement/next-segment boundaries, not proof of next morning.
